ary.description: ndarray Array to be divided into sub-arrays.

indices_or_sections.description: int or 1-D array If `indices_or_sections` is an integer, N, the array will be divided into N equal arrays along `axis`. If such a split is not possible, an error is raised.
constraints: indices_or_sections must be int or 1-D array with sorted values

axis.description: int, optional The axis along which to split, default is 0.
constraints: axis must be in range [0, rank(ary))

output.description: ------- list of ndarrays A list of sub-arrays as views into `ary`.
